home.title: Wood-fired pizza, on Via del Forno.
home.intro: We knead by hand every morning and let the dough rise for more than 24 hours. In the evening, from Tuesday to Sunday, the pizzas come out of the wood-fired oven: you can eat them here, pick them up or have them brought to your door.
home.story1: Gianni opened it in 2011: he wanted to use quality ingredients and bring real Neapolitan dough to the neighbourhood, with a long rise and a wood-fired oven. The menu is short: we'd rather make a few pizzas and look after each one.
home.story2: It's classic Neapolitan pizza, with a tall, soft crust, baked in the wood-fired oven at 450 degrees. The dough rises naturally for a long time, 24 hours: it takes longer, but the pizza comes out lighter and easier to digest.
home.story3: The classic pizzas use San Marzano PDO tomatoes; we get cheese and vegetables from local producers, and the vegetables follow the season. We make the dough and choose what goes on top.
home.cardSummary: There are {{total}} pizzas on the menu, {{vegetarian}} of them vegetarian: from the {{cheapest}} at {{cheapestPrice}} to the {{priciest}} at {{priciestPrice}}. Tap a name to see the ingredients. Gluten-free dough is available too.
home.contactTitle: Find us at Via del Forno 12, Rome
home.contactText: To book a table or place an order, give us a call. You can pick the pizza up or we'll bring it to your door: delivery costs €1.

menu.title: The pizzas
menu.intro: They all start from the same dough, made by hand and left to rise for 24 hours, and bake in the wood-fired oven. If you don't eat meat, tick “vegetarian only”.

glutenFree.name: Gluten-free dough
glutenFree.note: Available as an add-on to any pizza
